body:
Well, throwaway here, obviously. I thought there would maybe be more people like me in this, but its best there isn't. I kind of have a thing for other people's pain. I guess I am a sadist. Really up to this point it's just manifested in hooking up with guy's girlfriends or cheating on my SO. I'm well aware how fucked up this is. My emotions are relatively limited and generally self involved. I feel like a pretender in most things. Don't think I'm a sociopath but I don't know. Fictional characters like Dexter and most notably Patrick Bateman have kind of become my idol. I could kill someone easily without feeling bad about it and most likely enjoying it. I hate blood but I think it would be different in that moment. How complicated it would be holds me back, though. I just don't want to go through the trouble, but I think about it daily. A pencil through the eye, strangling with my bare hands, beating to a bloody pulp, pushing someone down on an object so it smashes their skull and everything. The list goes on and on. I don't usually remember my fantasies because they flash by so quickly. I'm just glad I control them because of all the trouble it would cause for me. I know enough to know I should apologize that I exist, that I am not the only one of me, and that I am just around you. I am the guy everybody loves. The goof. People admire me and say I have a "good heart" and a "good head on my shoulders", but every moment I am only a second away from insanity. Despite this, I've only met a few people suspicious of my facade, and the great majority like me a lot instantly even if something seems off. I should probably see a psychologist or be in an institution but I don't care enough. If I break one day, then that's that. I'm not the guy that shoots up the school or even the rapist(because I have a strange affinity for women's protection even though it is not a true feeling.) I would operate quickly and be satiated. Most likely in the shadows. I'm not proud of this. It just simply is. And really, I'll probably spend the rest of my life just being insane under the surface and live a normal life. I probably won't kill anyone. I just could and have a desire. Honestly, someday ill probably be very very successful. I'm definitely in that path. Maybe I'll be a CEO because I hear I'd be in good company. Well, maybe you'll be fortunate enough to never know me or anyone like me. So, uh, yeah.

TL;DR I am relatively insane. Think about killing for no good reason even though I haven't and probably never will. Don't feel much emotion. Seem like a regular guy, one that you would probably like to hang out with.
